Name: Hojichas' Walls and Floors (Content Patcher)
Author: hojichas
Description:
[size=5]Hojichas' Walls and Floors
[/size]
A simple and desaturated replacement for wallpaper and flooring. Much thanks to [url=http://ayene-chan.deviantart.com/]Ayene[/url] for some of the flooring used!

[b]Aug. 10, 2018:[/b] Can now be used with Content Patcher!

[size=4]Install for Content Patcher[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
[*]﻿Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods﻿.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
